findings.description: Potential race condition due to Condition object usage in cache decorator
findings.reasoning: CodeQL flags line 28 as potential race condition due to threading synchronization issues. The line creates a new threading.Condition() object for each cache decorator. While Condition objects provide synchronization, the concern is whether this Condition is properly shared across all threads accessing the same cache instance. If multiple decorated functions share the same cache instance but have different Condition objects, race conditions could occur. However, typical usage patterns (e.g., @fifo_cache) create a new cache instance per decorator, so the Condition is dedicated to that cache. Further manual review is needed to determine if there are scenarios where cache sharing across functions with different Condition objects could lead to data corruption.
